author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: BAMS is now among the trending degree courses in Rajasthan. Medical colleges are considering expanding their curriculum by making this course available to their peers. The Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery shares a degree program of 5.5 years. It is an undergraduate course that provides a hands-on experience in Ayurveda. There are a total of 18 colleges that offer BAMS admission in Rajasthan. In this article, we are going to cover details regarding BAMS in Rajasthan. It includes the admission process, eligibility, fee structure, and top colleges in the state.

sections.heading: How to Get Admission in BAMS in Rajasthan

content.text: For all the students who want to take admission to the BAMS course, must know that the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) is considered mandatory for selection. The qualified candidates are required to attend the counselling session to choose the college they want to take admission in. The conducting authority of the Rajasthan AYUSH counselling is the Rajasthan NEET AYUSH UG/PG Counselling Board, Jodhpur. BAMS Vacancy in Rajasthan is limited, as there are a total of 1192 BAMS seats available in the state. The private colleges take in 532 students, while the government ones take 658 students for BAMS admission in Rajasthan.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Rajasthan

content.text: BAMS admission in Rajasthan is conducted through a disciplined procedure. We are providing in the following section a step-by-step guide to help the students get a rough idea about the whole admission process.
Step 1: At first, enroll yourself for appearing in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG). Score high marks for a higher chance of acceptance.

Step 2: Next, register yourself on the official Rajasthan state counselling portal . Log in using your credentials and fill up the form with proper details of your academic and personal information. Submit the form by uploading all relevant documents.
Step 3: On a certain date, the online counselling will happen. Attend it to make your choice about the preferred colleges for BAMS admission in Rajasthan.

Step 4: After that, the Rajasthan NEET AYUSH UG/PG Counselling Board will publish a list. They will allot the seats for BAMS admission, depending on the NEET score and seat availability in the college.

Step 5: Once you are allotted a seat, the next step requires you to report to the college. Carry all the necessary documents with you(Originals and Photocopies). These are necessary to complete the document verification.
Step 6: The final step is to pay the fees. This finalizes the candidature for BAMS admission in Rajasthan. It ultimately books your seat at the allotted college.

There are 4 rounds of counselling (Round 1, Round 2, Mop-up Round, and Stray Vacancy Round) in Rajasthan. If one is not allotted to a college in a round, he/she must wait for the next round of counselling sessions.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Rajasthan

content.text: Students looking into BAMS admission in Rajasthan must be aware of the eligibility criteria. The criteria is provided below.

items: Candidates have to complete their 10+2 class from a recognized board.
They must have a science stream with PCB subjects in their 12th board exam.
An aggregate of a minimum of 50% or above must be obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Biology. (For reserved candidates – 40% and for PwD candidates – 45%)

Qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG), conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Score above the cut-off marks. It is set by the Rajasthan NEET AYUSH UG/PG Counselling Board, Jodhpur.
All willing students must be aged 17 and above in the admission year.

sections.heading: Documents Required for BAMS Admission in Rajasthan

content.text: A prescribed set of documents is published on the official website of Rajasthan AYUSH Counselling. Candidates must carry them along at the time of reporting to their allotted college(both originals and photocopies). Failing to produce any single one of them may hamper the process of BAMS admission in Rajasthan. The list of documents are given below.

items: Seat Allotment Letter.
NEET Scorecard
Any government-approved ID Proof: Aadhaar card, Voter ID card, Passport, PAN, etc.
Class 10th and 12th Marksheet
Class 10th and 12th Passing Certificates
NEET Admit Card
8-12 Passport Size Photographs (Recent)
Caste Certificate (If applicable)
Physically Handicapped Certificate (If applicable)
Domicile Certificate (for students applying in the state quota)
Family Income Certificate (applicable for EWS candidates)

While the private colleges offer the best infrastructure, the government colleges have the best placement record and nourished faculty. Also, the seat availability is different in those private and government colleges.

sections.heading: BAMS Fees in Rajasthan

content.text: The government of India and the Ministry of AYUSH jointly agreed that the BAMS colleges can have their own fee structure. So, BAMS fees in Rajasthan are different in each private and government college.

The government ones are cheaper compared to the private ones. They have a renowned faculty that shapes the peers for the future. If a candidate wants the detailed fee structure, we ask them to visit the official website of the college or connect with us.

BAMS Careers in Rajasthan

content.text: The first thing that comes to a student’s mind is what jobs they are going to get after completion of their degree. It is a major thought indeed. But don’t worry! There are ample job opportunities for BAMS graduates in Rajasthan. Both private and govt jobs for BAMS doctors in Rajasthan are available. Also, other BAMS jobs in Rajasthan include posts like –

items: Medical Officer
Ayurvedic Doctor
Clinical Researcher
Healthcare Specialist

content.text: The average BAMS salary in Rajasthan ranges from ₹3 LPA to ₹17 LPA. Apart from careers, willing students can also pursue higher studies. There are MD/MS Ayurvedic degrees and PhD in Ayurveda available in the colleges of Rajasthan.
